start.description: Index of the first item to return

end.description: Index of the last item to return

Playlist.UnresolvedItem.description: An item that was not added, and why.

item.description: The item exactly as the client asked for it.

reason.description: "notfound": the item does not exist. "unavailable": it exists but cannot be reached at the moment, so the reference is worth keeping and retrying. "invalid": the item cannot go in a playlist of this type, or holds nothing playable.

Playlist.AddResult.description: The outcome of adding or inserting items. Items that could not be resolved are skipped and named in "unresolved".

added.description: How many items were added. Never zero; a call that adds nothing returns an error.

unresolved.description: One entry per item that was not added, in request order. Empty when every item was added.

file.description: Path to a file (not a directory) to be added to the playlist

genreid.description: Identification of a genre from the AudioLibrary

anyOf.description: Pixel aspect ratio where 1.0 means square pixel
Vertical shift 1.0 means shift to bottom

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, en-AU), empty when the stream declares none, passed through unchanged when unrecognized

anyOf.description: An unknown item does not have any additional information.
An item known to the database has an identification.
A movie item has a title and may have a release year.
A tv episode has a title and may have an episode number, season number and the title of the show it belongs to.
A music video has a title and may have an album and an artist.
A song has a title and may have an album, an artist and a track number.
A picture has a file path.
A PVR channel is either a radio or tv channel and has a title.

file.description: The url encoded multipath string combining all paths of the source

paths.description: The individual paths of the media source

sourceid.description: The ids of sources with songs of the genre

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en), a language only in library values, empty when the stream declares none, passed through unchanged when unrecognized

source.description: Where the stream details came from: 0 undefined, 10 an external source, 20 the media file, 30 an NFO file, 40 a database migrated from before sources were tracked

version.description: Version of the stream details record

flags.description: Bitmask of the stream's dispositions: 1 default, 2 dub, 4 original, 8 commentary, 16 lyrics, 32 karaoke, 64 forced, 128 hearing impaired, 256 visually impaired

version.description: Version of the stream details record

flags.description: Bitmask of the stream's dispositions: 1 default, 2 dub, 4 original, 8 commentary, 16 lyrics, 32 karaoke, 64 forced, 128 hearing impaired, 256 visually impaired

parentalratingicon.description: Image URL for the icon of this broadcast's parental rating, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint. Empty when the rating has no icon.

thumbnail.description: Image URL for this broadcast's own artwork, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint. Empty when the broadcast has no image.

recordingid.description: Identifies the recording of this broadcast for PVR.GetRecordingDetails. -1 when the broadcast has no recording.

thumbnail.description: Image URL for the channel's own logo, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint. This is the channel's logo, never the currently airing broadcast's artwork - for that, read thumbnail from broadcastnow.

channeluid.description: The channel's own identifier on the client that provides it. A broadcast and a recording report the same value as channeluid. Unrelated to uniqueid on a library item, which is a set of scraper identifiers.

icon.description: Image URL for the channel's own logo, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint.

iconpath.description: Image URL for the provider's own icon, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint.

countries.description: ISO 3166 country codes this provider serves.

languages.description: RFC 5646 language codes this provider broadcasts in.

title.description: Title of the recorded item itself. For a recorded episode this is the episode's own name and showtitle carries the show; for anything else it is the programme title and showtitle is empty.

parentalratingicon.description: Image URL for the icon of this recording's parental rating, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint. Empty when the rating has no icon.

icon.description: Image URL for the recording's own icon, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint.

episodepart.description: Part number of a multi-part episode. Zero when the episode is not in parts.

showtitle.description: Title of the show this recording is an episode of. Empty when the recording is not of an episode.

titleextrainfo.description: Additional information the client supplies alongside the title, such as a sub title or a programme classification. Empty when the client supplies none.

lasthashcheck.description: Last time source was checked for changes

lastlibrarycheck.description: Last time texture existence was verified in library

stationname.description: Name of the radio station an internet stream is served by

mediapath.description: Media source path that identifies the item

dynpath.description: An experimental property for debug purposes, often same as mediapath but when different gives the actual file playing that should also be in file property

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

ready.description: True once the interface has finished starting and a skin is loaded with its first window active. False while Kodi is still starting and while a skin is reloading. A client that polls can wait on this rather than on the web server answering, which only proves the JSON-RPC service is up.

Application.LogLevel.description: How much is written to the log: nothing, errors and notices, everything, or everything with the free-memory overlay the interface shows while debug logging is on

name.description: the component's own name, stable across languages and versions

enabled.description: whether the component's extra logging is in force

components.description: every log component this build knows, and whether each is enabled

sorttokens.description: Articles ignored during sorting when ignorearticle is enabled.

language.description: Current language code and region e.g. en_GB

Player.Chapter.description: Single chapter of the currently playing video

time.description: Chapter position in seconds from start
